name: Text to Card

releases.author: monvhh
releases.description:
## What's changed

- Add direct card generation commands and a dedicated preview workflow.
- Add editable preview settings, page ratios, font presets, and local image pickers.
- Simplify the preview interface and move reusable branding options into brand presets.
- Add optional Obsidian note-title injection for generated cards.
- Keep card backgrounds consistent across Obsidian themes.
- Align brand logos and refine minimalist magazine signature styling.
- Hide unfinished custom-template UI while retaining its documented implementation.
- Improve mobile behavior, documentation, and configuration tests.

## Update

Update from Obsidian's Community Plugins page after version 1.0.6 becomes available.
releases.name: Text to Card 1.0.6

releases.author: monvhh
releases.description:
## Review cleanup

- Resolve Obsidian source-code and CSS review warnings
- Adopt searchable settings definitions with backward-compatible rendering
- Use popout-compatible `window` access and safe `TFile` narrowing
- Respect the user's deletion preference through `FileManager.trashFile()`
- Remove deprecated slider APIs and redundant type assertions
- Keep browser preview behavior unchanged

## Installation

Download `main.js`, `manifest.json`, and `styles.css`, then place them in `.obsidian/plugins/xhs-text-card/`.

releases.author: monvhh
releases.description:
## Highlights

- Generate multi-page Xiaohongshu-style image cards from an Obsidian note or selection
- Includes 12 templates, Canvas preview, page editing, batch generation, presets, and custom templates
- Supports Obsidian links, embeds, callouts, task lists, footnotes, properties, and local browser preview

## Installation

Download `main.js`, `manifest.json`, and `styles.css`, then place them in `.obsidian/plugins/xhs-text-card/`.

See the repository README for full usage, privacy, and attribution details.
